acceptance_checks: CCA and Claude workflow official GitHub actions no longer rely on the T-0039 Node 24 deferred official-action exceptions.
Affected workflows set FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24=true and continue to forbid ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION.
Official GitHub actions use verified Node 24-compatible pinned versions: checkout v6, upload-artifact v7, and download-artifact v8 where applicable.
anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 remains a documented exact workflow/action/version defer for CCA and Claude review workflows only.
scripts/validate_shiki.py rejects unsafe Node opt-outs, deprecated official action versions, wildcard action versions, and changed Anthropic action versions that are not explicitly configured.
scripts/test_shiki_validator_hardening.sh covers exact defer acceptance, docs inventory coverage, changed-version rejection, wildcard rejection, and official action rejection.
docs/agents/node24-workflow-compatibility.md inventories every affected workflow action and records post-merge verification expectations.
Runtime auth, decision-control, and checklist docs distinguish Node runtime compatibility from Guardian approval, CCA Review Bridge, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, and other governance behavior.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, git diff --check, and local actionlint/shellcheck wrappers.
